name: Four Seasons Hotel Kuwait at Burj Alshaya
insider_take: This architectural marvel stands as Kuwait's tallest hotel tower, offering unparalleled luxury in the heart of the Middle East's cultural crossroads.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 18-33 of the iconic Burj Alshaya, Kuwait's first mixed-use skyscraper. The property features the highest spa in Kuwait and houses the country's most elevated fine dining restaurant. Each room offers panoramic views of either the Arabian Gulf or Kuwait's dramatic desert landscape.
pro_tip: Book a Gulf-facing room during winter months (November-March) for spectacular sunset views and cooler temperatures perfect for enjoying the outdoor terraces.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool experience at sunset, and venture to nearby Souq Al-Mubarakiya, Kuwait's oldest traditional market, just 10 minutes away. The Kuwait Towers, an architectural icon and symbol of modern Kuwait, are within walking distance and offer incredible city views.
pros: Iconic tower location in Kuwait City's business district
Exceptional Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Premium dining options and spa facilities
Modern accommodations with panoramic city views
